title: Managing Multiple Tasks
overview: Realizing visions and goals involves comprehending tasks, setting priorities, and establishing well-defined deadlines. This course is structured to assist participants in cultivating the necessary skills to effectively manage tasks, assess and prioritize them, and schedule activities within clearly defined timelines. The program encompasses diverse methods and techniques to foster a sense of ownership over tasks while promoting collaboration with other team members. Additionally, it addresses the art of influencing others by appropriately setting expectations and ensuring the successful completion of tasks
audience: This course is tailored for professionals across various industries who seek to gain essential skills for establishing and enhancing an effective and efficient workplace environment. It is specifically designed for team leaders, supervisors, managers, and section heads
methodology: The course incorporates self-assessments and a diverse range of business cases to foster meaningful discussions on the significance of managing multiple tasks, deadlines, and priorities. Participants will gain valuable insights through role-playing exercises that address workplace challenges associated with handling tasks, deadlines, and priorities
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Illustrate the Connection Between Strategic Planning and Task Achievement
Define Task Objectives, Constraints, and Stakeholders
Establish Priorities and Deadlines for Tasks
Enhance Task Outcomes in Group and Team Environments
Effectively Communicate, Justify, and Persuade Others Regarding Changes to Task Assignments
